description: Turn a description of a part, with its sizes, into a dimensioned 2D technical drawing: orthographic views plus an isometric, dimension lines, centre lines and the projection symbol. No photo needed. Every number in the prompt is drawn as given; sizes the prompt leaves out are estimated and the sheet says UNSTATED DIMENSIONS NOMINAL. So put every size you know in the prompt. The image is the views only, with no border or title block. It is a picture, not CAD geometry: the drawn lines are not to exact scale. Costs 5 credits and takes about 30 to 60 seconds. The drawing is saved to disk and its path returned.

output_path.description: Where to save the drawing. Defaults to ./techdrawai-output/text-drawing-<timestamp>.png.

paper_size.description: ISO sheet the views are proportioned for. Defaults to A3.

projection.description: Projection angle. Defaults to first-angle on ISO, third-angle on ANSI.

prompt.description: What the part is and every size you know, e.g. "Steel L bracket, legs 80 and 60 mm, 40 wide, 5 thick, two 8.5 mm holes in each leg". Name materials and tolerances here too if they belong on the drawing.

standard.description: Drafting standard. ISO (default) or ANSI (ASME, drawn for an ANSI B sheet).

units.description: Units of the bare numbers in the prompt. Omit to read them from the prompt (an inch mark or "in" means inches, otherwise mm).

name: text_to_technical_drawing
title: Draw a part from a written description
